description: This file defines and manages RPC backend registration and initialization for PyTorch distributed system, including backend types, registration functions, and backend-specific setup handlers.

classes.name: BackendValue
classes.description: Named tuple holding handlers for constructing backend options and initialization.

classes.name: BackendType
classes.description: Enum class representing available backend types, extendable via registration functions.

methods.name: _backend_type_repr
methods.description: Returns string representation of BackendType enum member.

methods.name: backend_registered
methods.description: Checks if a backend name is already registered.

methods.name: register_backend
methods.description: Registers a new RPC backend with specified handlers and extends the BackendType enum.

methods.name: construct_rpc_backend_options
methods.description: Constructs backend options using the registered handler.

methods.name: init_backend
methods.description: Initializes the backend using the registered handler.

methods.name: _init_process_group
methods.description: Initializes a process group for distributed communication.

methods.name: _tensorpipe_validate_devices
methods.description: Validates device configurations for TensorPipe backend.

methods.name: _tensorpipe_exchange_and_check_all_device_maps
methods.description: Exchanges device maps among workers and validates configurations.

methods.name: _validate_device_maps
methods.description: Validates device maps for correctness and consistency.

methods.name: _create_device_list
methods.description: Creates a sorted list of devices from device maps.

methods.name: _create_reverse_mapping
methods.description: Creates reverse device mappings for workers.

methods.name: _get_device_infos
methods.description: Retrieves device info from the current RPC agent.

methods.name: _set_devices_and_reverse_device_map
methods.description: Sets device configurations and reverse mappings for all workers.

methods.name: _tensorpipe_init_backend_handler
methods.description: Initializes TensorPipe backend, handling static and dynamic groups.
